resources.string: Cross-App Agent (screen reader for the agent)

Lets the Cross-App Agent read the on-screen UI tree of other apps and perform taps, text input and scrolls on your behalf while you run a task. Screen content is sent to a cloud model only while a task is running. Password fields are redacted before anything leaves the device. This is an engineering experiment, not an assistive technology.
